variant.title: Arrow Thermometer Sudoku
variant.description: Thermometers increase from bulb to tip, and arrow circles equal their path sums.
rule.thermometer_order: Digits must strictly increase along the thermometer.
rule.arrow_sum: The arrow circle must equal the sum of its path.
rule_guide.title: Arrow Thermometer Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Digits on each thermometer must strictly increase from bulb to tip.
rule_guide.item_3: Each arrow circle must equal the sum of the digits along its arrow path.
